name: customer
comment: Legacy line-grain invoice data from the company's original online retail system (UK-style invoice export: one row per product line per invoice). Represents the earliest e-commerce channel prior to the current D2C storefront, retained for historical continuity.

columns.name: hash_key
columns.comment: Deterministic hash of this record's natural/business key, generated during ingestion. Used internally for deduplication and change-detection; not a business attribute and should not be used for reporting.

columns.name: invoice_no
columns.comment: Invoice number from the legacy retail system. A single invoice can span multiple rows (one per product line); a prefix of 'C' denotes a cancelled invoice.

columns.name: stock_code
columns.comment: Legacy system's internal product code for the line item.

columns.name: description
columns.comment: Product description text as recorded in the legacy system at time of sale.

columns.name: quantity
columns.comment: Units of this product on this invoice line. Negative values indicate a cancellation/credit line.

columns.name: invoice_date
columns.comment: Timestamp the invoice line was recorded.

columns.name: unit_price
columns.comment: Unit price charged for this line, in the legacy system's transaction currency.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.comment: Legacy system's customer identifier for this invoice. May be blank for guest/unidentified checkouts.

columns.name: country
columns.comment: Country the order was shipped to, as recorded by the legacy system.

columns.name: is_cancelled
columns.comment: TRUE when this invoice line is a cancellation/credit (mirrors the 'C'-prefixed invoice_no).

columns.name: line_amount
columns.comment: Line amount for this invoice line (quantity * unit_price).

columns.name: channel_code
columns.comment: Short code identifying the sales channel this record belongs to (e.g. D2C, OFFLINE, QCOMM, PLATFORM, INTL, CAFE). Joins to dim_channels for the channel's full name, group and settlement currency.

columns.name: insert_timestamp
columns.comment: UTC timestamp when this record was first loaded into the silver layer. Reflects pipeline load time, not a business event time.

columns.name: modified_timestamp
columns.comment: UTC timestamp when this record was last updated by the ingestion pipeline. Reflects pipeline processing time, not a business event time.

columns.name: source_name
columns.comment: Name of the upstream source system or source file this record was ingested from. Used for data lineage and troubleshooting, not for business analysis.

columns.name: is_deleted
columns.comment: Soft-delete flag set by the ingestion pipeline when the source record was removed or tombstoned upstream. Rows where this is TRUE should normally be excluded from business reporting.
